shap_note: SHAP computed on a tree-based surrogate model over engineered features. Top features are ranked by mean absolute SHAP value.

feature_queries.name: user_posts
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(p.Id) AS n_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_questions, SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_answers, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(p.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_post, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_90d, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', p.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_180d, COUNT(DISTINCT p.CreationDate) AS distinct_post_days, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Tags) AS distinct_tags FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: user_comments
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(c.Id) AS n_comments, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(c.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_comment, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_90d, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_180d, COUNT(DISTINCT c.CreationDate) AS distinct_comment_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: user_badges
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(b.Id) AS n_badges, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_badges_gold, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_badges_silver, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_badges_bronze, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(b.Date), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_badge FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: user_history
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(h.Id) AS n_history, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(h.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_history, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', h.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS history_90d, SUM(CASE WHEN h.PostHistoryTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hist_initial, SUM(CASE WHEN h.PostHistoryTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hist_initial_body, SUM(CASE WHEN h.PostHistoryTypeId=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hist_edit, SUM(CASE WHEN h.PostHistoryTypeId=8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hist_comment FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN postHistory h ON h.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND h.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: post_votes
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(v.Id) AS n_votes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_accepts_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_downvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', v.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_received_90d, DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(v.CreationDate), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_vote_received FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId=p.Id AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: post_comments
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(c.Id) AS n_comments_received, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', c.CreationDate, e.timestamp) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_received_90d FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId=p.Id AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: user_meta
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, DATE_DIFF('day', u.CreationDate, e.timestamp) AS tenure_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id=e.OwnerUserId

feature_queries.name: combined_activity
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, DATE_DIFF('day', (SELECT MAX(dt) FROM (SELECT MAX(p.CreationDate) AS dt FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId=e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp UNION ALL SELECT MAX(c.CreationDate) FROM comments c WHERE c.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp UNION ALL SELECT MAX(b.Date) FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp UNION ALL SELECT MAX(h.CreationDate) FROM postHistory h WHERE h.UserId=e.OwnerUserId AND h.CreationDate < e.timestamp)), e.timestamp) AS days_since_last_activity FROM eval_table e
